''Hintonia latiflora var. leiantha'' }} '''''Hintonia latiflora''''' is a plant species in the genus ''[[Hintonia (plant)|Hintonia]]''.[http://data.gbif.org/species/14248597 Hintonia on data.gbif.org] ''Hintonia latiflora'' contains the [[neoflavonoid]] [[coutareagenin]] (5-hydroxy-7-methoxy-4-(3,4-dihydroxyphenyl)-2H-benzo-1-pyran-2-ol), an [[antidiabetic]] active substance.[http://cat.inist.fr/?aModele=afficheN&cpsidt=1285556 Effects of the neoflavonoid coutareagenin, one of the antidiabetic active substances of Hintonia latiflora, on streptozotocin-induced diabetes mellitus in rats.
